# AgentAnycast Relay

> Relay server for AgentAnycast — provides Circuit Relay v2, AutoNAT signaling, and a skill registry for anycast discovery. Docker-deployable.

## Documentation

- [Architecture](https://github.com/AgentAnycast/agentanycast/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): NAT traversal and relay design
- [Deployment](https://github.com/AgentAnycast/agentanycast/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): Relay setup, Docker, resource limits

## Build & Run

```bash
# Build binary
go build -o agentanycast-relay ./cmd/relay

# Run tests
go test ./...

# Docker
docker build -t agentanycast/relay .
docker compose up                    # Run with persistent key storage
```

## Key Components

### Circuit Relay v2
Relays traffic between peers that cannot establish direct connections. Wraps libp2p Circuit Relay v2 with configurable resource limits (max reservations, bandwidth, duration).

### AutoNAT Signaling
Helps peers detect their external address and NAT type. Enables DCUtR hole punching when possible.

### Skill Registry
gRPC service for anycast discovery. Agents register their skills; peers query to find agents by capability.

- `RegisterSkills` — agent registers available skills with the relay
- `UnregisterSkills` — agent removes skills on shutdown
- `DiscoverBySkill` — client queries for peers offering a specific skill
- `Heartbeat` — agents send periodic heartbeats to maintain registration

## Key Concepts

- **Stateless relay**: Relay does not inspect or store message content
- **Resource limits**: Configurable max connections, bandwidth caps, reservation timeouts
- **Persistent identity**: Ed25519 key stored on disk for stable PeerID across restarts
- **Docker-ready**: Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml included with volume for key persistence

## Related Repositories
